champion: Small cell carcinoma of the ovary
ordered_diagnoses: Small cell carcinoma of the ovary

facts.raw_span: A 70-year-old woman presented with a 2-month history of progressive abdominal distension
Pelvic ultrasound revealed an 18-cm solid–cystic mass occupying the pelvic and abdominal cavities with rich intralesional blood flow
serum CA-125 level of 367.9 U/mL
neuron-specific enolase of 24.83 ng/mL
CYFRA21-1 of 3.85 ng/mL
0.5 L of hemorrhagic ascites was evacuated
a 20-cm right ovarian cystic and solid mass infiltrating the uterus, intestinal loops, and parietal pelvic wall
diffuse peritoneal implants on the surface of the uterus and intestines
the left ovary, fallopian tube, and pelvic and para-aortic lymph nodes appeared normal
frozen section analysis demonstrated a poorly differentiated carcinoma
the right ovarian tumor measured 33 × 23 × 5 cm, had a fragile nodular “rotten-flesh” surface
Histologic examination of H&E-stained sections revealed predominantly trabecular and rosette-like formations of pleomorphic hyperchromatic tumor cells

concepts.preferred_label: Small cell carcinoma of the ovary
support_spans: a 20-cm right ovarian cystic and solid mass infiltrating the uterus, intestinal loops, and parietal pelvic wall
frozen section analysis demonstrated a poorly differentiated carcinoma
Histologic examination of H&E-stained sections revealed predominantly trabecular and rosette-like formations of pleomorphic hyperchromatic tumor cells
concepts.why: The presence of a large ovarian mass with diffuse peritoneal implants and a poorly differentiated carcinoma on frozen section analysis, along with the histologic findings of trabecular and rosette-like formations, are unusual and point towards small cell carcinoma of the ovary.

contradict_spans: frozen section analysis demonstrated a poorly differentiated carcinoma
concepts.why: The presence of a large ovarian mass with elevated CA-125 levels and a normal left ovary, fallopian tube, and lymph nodes are findings that can be seen in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma, but the poorly differentiated carcinoma on frozen section analysis is unusual for this diagnosis.

support_spans: neuron-specific enolase of 24.83 ng/mL
contradict_spans: Histologic examination of H&E-stained sections revealed predominantly trabecular and rosette-like formations of pleomorphic hyperchromatic tumor cells
concepts.why: The elevated neuron-specific enolase level is unusual and points towards an ovarian neuroendocrine tumor, but the histologic findings do not support this diagnosis.

support_spans: the right ovarian tumor measured 33 × 23 × 5 cm, had a fragile nodular “rotten-flesh” surface
contradict_spans: frozen section analysis demonstrated a poorly differentiated carcinoma
concepts.why: The large size and fragile nodular surface of the ovarian tumor are unusual and can be seen in ovarian carcinosarcoma, but the poorly differentiated carcinoma on frozen section analysis is not typical for this diagnosis.
